answer_2.quote: We employ several statistical measures to quantify the stability of model responses across multiple runs. The Test-Retest Consistency Score (TRCS) captures the proportion of identical re‑responses across repeated trials... The Intraclass Correlation Coefficient (ICC) assesses the reliability of model outputs across multiple iterations. In addition, we use Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) to determine whether differences in consistency scores across models are statistically significant.
